owner_instruction_excerpt: DIAL DEVELOPMENT & PRODUCT INTELLIGENCE / AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE Rev 3.1 — Fully implement
notes: Owner supplied Rev 3.1 of the umbrella architecture and instructed full implementation. The implementation is bounded to the three workstreams the document defines and the contracts they require.

No existing authority was replaced. Every extension point was measured against the committed baseline rather than asserted: design-authority-projector, design-provider-router and design-candidate-admission produce byte-identical output for every legacy input, proven in guided-design-architecture-check.mjs by importing HEAD's version of each module and comparing.

The discovery plane is a staging ledger, not a second registry. Trust tiers are the existing T0-T4 source vocabulary verbatim; admission writes into ENGINEERING_RESOURCE_SOURCE_REGISTRY / ENGINEERING_RESOURCE_REGISTRY. Open-world discovery cannot mint T0.

The n8n runtime node policy is compiled FROM n8n-node-capability-map.json rather than restated. The compiler refuses to start if an estate names a capability the corpus does not know, so the runtime cannot be looser than the corpus knowledge it claims to project.

DEC-033, DEC-034 and DEC-035 are recorded as PROPOSED, not LOCKED. Every existing decision in the log is LOCKED and locking is an owner act; the owner instruction authorises the implementation and the records, and the owner decides when they lock.

This commit touches agent-system/orchestration and agent-system/engineering-knowledge, which are fingerprinted control-plane paths. The control-plane fingerprint therefore changes and prior external qualification is invalidated until Oracle requalifies it. The baseline fingerprint at fa7c655 was 1951e5bbd1fa42b63c15ef27d2dec4edcb9187e9e067c137853b0d7d1e36ded7; the new value is recorded in the Rev 3.1 evidence document. Requalification is an Oracle/owner action this client cannot perform and does not claim.

Three estates of live work are explicitly NOT done and are not claimed: no n8n estate is stood up (deploy descriptors and a qualified contract exist; standing up a VM is an Oracle/owner action), no live Stitch design provider call was made, and no external provenance for the seeded discovery candidate could be verified because outbound GitHub reads are scoped to this repository. The seeded candidate therefore sits at DISCOVERED/T4_COMMUNITY_SIGNAL, which is the correct fail-closed outcome rather than a gap papered over.
Executable trials, discovery adapters, horizon scanning and both n8n estates ship behind feature flags that default to false. Nothing new executes until an owner turns it on.

MANIFEST_v2_2.json, BUILD_READINESS_SCORECARD.json and DEVELOPMENT_UNIT_REGISTRY.json are in scope as derived artifacts only. Each was regenerated with its own repository tooling (agent:manifest-write, scorecard-refresh.mjs, development-unit-planner.mjs write) rather than edited by hand, and each moved for a traceable reason: the manifest and scorecard because four canon documents were added, the unit registry because project_truth_hash and technical_stack_fingerprint changed when DECISION_LOG.json (an AUTHORITY_PATHS member) and package.json were modified under this authorization. package-lock.json did not change. No product, business or security meaning is carried by any of the three.
